title: Dynamic pinecones
description: Add pinecones to grow on spruce trees. Make them into brown dye and smelt them to turn them into charcaoal!
body: Dynamic Pinecones adds pickable pinecones to natural spruce leaves. Pinecones hang from exposed leaves, can be collected by right-clicking, and drop when their leaf breaks. They work as furnace fuel, compost for bonemeal, smelt into charcoal, place as small ground decorations, and interact with campfires as kindling or smoky crackle bursts. Compatible with Dynamic Apples and Dynamic Acorns because pinecones use spruce leaves.
